Tour ParserSalesforce booking list → verified normalized Tours, read by its Header Layout.
Parser v0.7
Click here and press Ctrl+V — Waypoint will show the captured rows and the copied N of N reconciliation immediately.
Paste a booking list to verify and parse it.
CompletenessCompares Salesforce's own item count to the rows captured. A green result means the copy reconciled and no row failed parsing.
Schedule ViewShows Resort · Booking · Account · Date · Time · Mode · Status. Confirmation, Phone, Tour Type, Booked By, raw Method, and raw Virtual remain in the record.
ModeDisplays Virtual or Kiosk from the source Method + Virtual fields. Source contradictions are warnings; the parser never edits Salesforce data.
Worksheet ParserUpgrade Worksheet PDF → normalized record
Parser v0.7
Drop the worksheet PDF here, or click to choose
reads the file locally — nothing is uploaded
Drop a worksheet PDF to parse it.
ParseLabel-anchored: every value is the text between its label and the next known label. The label list is the source of truth.
ValuesCaptured verbatim (typos, formats, the Trade Value pair all preserved). Blank fields shown in italic; nothing on the form is invented.
